negative_findings.description: Two WebFetch attempts against nabu.ua (the /ua/ homepage and /ua/vihidni-listi-nabu.html) both returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved from nabu.ua by direct fetch; all NABU URL structure in this slice was reconstructed from search-engine result titles and slugs, which show many distinct live pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: NABU is the single most important actor in this cell. A 429 is a rate-limit/bot-defence signal, NOT evidence the site is dead — the collector must use a slow, well-behaved crawler with a real user agent and backoff rather than marking these sources unreachable.

negative_findings.description: https://ukbs.org.ua/ (Український кредитно-банківський союз, named in the cell brief) failed DNS resolution: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND ukbs.org.ua.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not reach the UKBS site at all. Search results still present ukbs.org.ua as the official site, and third-party sources (Wikipedia uk, ua-region EDRPOU 21573585, jurliga) confirm the organisation exists and takes regulatory positions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the four named actors could not be characterised from its own site. This is a hypothesis (resolver/egress issue or lapsed domain), not a verdict; the deterministic liveness pass must re-test from a different network before the source is retired, and a fallback via legal-news coverage should be kept either way.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'positions / comments on draft acts' section was located on fintechua.org (UAFIC) despite two searches, one of them in Ukrainian.
negative_findings.result_summary: UAFIC's regulatory engagement is evidenced (round tables with regulators, joint working groups, participation in preparing draft laws, the Sept-2021 open-banking memorandum with NABU and other associations) but appears to be published as news items and event material, not as a structured consultation archive.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For UAFIC the collector cannot rely on a stable submissions page and must instead run text mining over the news feed and Telegram channel, which is noisier and needs different extraction rules.

negative_findings.description: The acronym НАБУ is severely overloaded: in this cell it means the banking association, but nationally it overwhelmingly denotes Національне антикорупційне бюро України (the National Anti-Corruption Bureau). The association itself is inconsistent, rendering its own name as both 'Незалежна асоціація банків України' and 'Національна асоціація банків України' across page titles on the same site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bare 'НАБУ' queries risk being dominated by anti-corruption-bureau news; the association must always be queried with a qualifier such as 'асоціація банків' or the nabu.ua domain.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Left unhandled this would poison both search-based discovery and any downstream entity resolution or deduplication in the collected corpus.

negative_findings.description: The payments association is written ЄМА (Ukrainian) and ЕМА (Russian/legacy) and EMA (Latin), with the domain ema.com.ua serving both www and bare-host variants and both /about/ and /about-association/ paths.
negative_findings.result_summary: All three spellings return relevant results; the site itself mixes URL patterns.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query sets and deduplication keys must cover all three spellings, or coverage of the payments-side association will be silently partial.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed, sitemap, or open API was confirmed for any of the four named association sites during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetches returned rendered HTML only; feed discovery was not possible for nabu.ua (429) and was not surfaced for ema.com.ua, aub.org.ua or fintechua.org.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must assume HTML scraping with slug-series enumeration (which the NABU monitoring and EMA news numbered series make feasible) rather than feed subscription; a targeted /feed, /rss, /sitemap.xml probe should be part of the verification pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Український кредитно-банківський союз (UKBS) — one of the four brief-named actors — has no characterised primary source because its domain did not resolve.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-attempt ukbs.org.ua from a different network/resolver and check the Wayback Machine for its structure; if truly offline, substitute LIGA:ZAKON/JURLIGA coverage plus the EDRPOU 21573585 registry card and check whether UKBS has merged into or is now represented by NABU/AUB.

coverage_gaps.description: NABU's 'Вихідні листи' archive — the actual consultation submissions — was never opened; only its existence and title are known.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch with a browser-grade client and slow rate to establish pagination, date range, attachment formats and whether addressee (НБУ / ВРУ комітет / КМУ) is exposed as structured metadata.

coverage_gaps.description: Member lists for NABU, AUB, EMA and UAFIC were identified as pages but not actually pulled, so the private-bank / PSP ecosystem map the cell rationale calls for does not yet exist.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated membership-extraction pass across all four rosters, reconcile to NBU's bank register and to the fintech catalogue PDF, and diff quarterly.

coverage_gaps.description: The Open API Group participant list surfaced further self-regulatory bodies not in the cell brief and not yet scouted: НАКСУ (credit unions), Blockchain Association of Ukraine, and the insurance association (НАСУ). VAFK was picked up; the others were not.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball each remaining OAG participant association into its own candidate entry — they are co-signatories on the same memoranda and will carry overlapping deadline summaries.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language association output was found only for AUB (full /en/ mirror) and via foreign intermediaries (USUBC, Lexology, PwC, Chambers). NABU, EMA, UAFIC and VAFK were only observed publishing in uk (and ru for NABU/EMA legacy).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Ukrainian as the mandatory primary collection language for this cell; budget machine translation rather than expecting English mirrors, and use the AUB /en/ tree as a slug-level bridge for cross-checking.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive depth is unknown for every association source; the NABU monitoring slug series reaches at least -74 and EMA dossiers span 2002-2024, but no start dates or retention policies were confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During verification, establish the earliest reachable item per source and pair each with a Wayback Machine baseline, since association sites are prone to CMS migrations (AUB already runs two parallel URL schemes: legacy index.php and modern permalinks).

coverage_gaps.description: No source was found that links a specific NBU draft resolution to the specific association responses it received — the regulator-side and association-side records are separate.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan a join at collection time: key association letters/positions to NBU draft-act identifiers and comment deadlines harvested by the regulator-facing cells, rather than expecting any single source to provide the mapping.

brief: Ukraine's banking and payments associations form a dense, mostly Ukrainian-language, and unusually document-rich consultation layer: NABU and AUB on the banking side, EMA on payments, UAFIC on fintech and VAFK on non-bank financial companies, with UKBS as the one named actor we could not reach. Three artefact types matter most and all were located: formal submissions to regulators (NABU's «Вихідні листи»), member-facing plain-language deadline digests (NABU's weekly «Моніторинг змін у фінсекторі», EMA's «Новини платіжного ринку», VAFK's rule explainers), and genuine self-regulation — EMA's Open API Group, which sets Ukraine's open-banking specification jointly with the NBU, and the association-coordinated Memorandum on payment-market transparency that imposes de-facto compliance deadlines outside formal regulation. Access is easy on ema.com.ua, aub.org.ua (which uniquely maintains a full English mirror), fintechua.org and vafk.com.ua, while nabu.ua is rate-limited (HTTP 429, bot-defended rather than dead) and ukbs.org.ua failed DNS resolution and must be re-tested before being written off. The main traps are naming: НАБУ collides with the National Anti-Corruption Bureau, the association renders its own name as both «Незалежна» and «Національна», and EMA appears as ЄМА/ЕМА/EMA — all of which must be encoded into query sets and entity resolution.
